site.name: Family First Medical
site.description: Bilingual family medicine and pediatrics practice with offices in Elmhurst, Queens and Hicksville, Long Island, NY. Board-certified physicians Dr. Qikai Yao, MD (pediatrics) and Dr. Liyan Yao, MD (family medicine). Open 7 days across two offices. Medicaid, Medicare and most insurances accepted. Care in English and Chinese; Spanish-speaking staff.
